name: feat-2894-b-3d
title: #2894 part 2 B — 3-D: a rename or a swap keeps the drawing in place (PR, port 5201)

cases.title: 3-D: renaming a vertex, then swapping two, changes only the letters: the triangle stays exactly where it was
cases.lookFor: Start from «נקה הכל». After «∠BAC = 40°» note where C is drawn. After «שנה שם A ל-Q» the vertex at A is labelled Q and nothing moves; after «החלף בין B ל-C» the two labels B and C trade places and nothing moves. Every row still reads green, with the new letters.
cases.before: prod redraws the triangle at the rename: with these two sides and this angle there are two triangles, and the rename flips to the other one (C jumps to about a quarter of the way along AB); the swap redraws it again.

cases.title: 3-D: a renamed cube vertex is re-lettered in every row and on the figure
cases.lookFor: Start from «נקה הכל». The rows read «קובייה MBCDA'B'C'D'» and «מישור MBCD»; M is drawn where A was, A' keeps its letter.
cases.before: unchanged (the cube has no free size, so prod draws it in place too)

cases.title: 3-D: renaming onto a letter the figure already uses is still refused, offering the swap
cases.lookFor: Start from «נקה הכל». «השם «B» כבר תפוס בציור — בחרו אות פנויה, או החליפו ביניהן: הקלידו «החלף בין A ל-B» (שינוי שם לאות תפוסה היה מאחד שתי נקודות)». The row stays «משולש ABC».
